headline: Margin gains outpace a revenue slowdown as taxes bite
summary_short: Nutanix's quarter ended April 30, 2026 revenue was $703M, up 10.0% y/y, with net income of $72M ($0.25 diluted EPS) as operating income grew 44.9% y/y to $71M and ARR climbed 14.9% y/y to $2.43B.
summary_long: Revenue growth decelerated to 10% y/y (from 22% a year ago) as subscription/support revenue (+15%) again outpaced product revenue (+6%); ARR rose 14.9% y/y to $2.43B. Operating income rose 44.9% y/y to $71M as sales & marketing, R&D, and G&A expenses each grew slower than revenue on measured 7-10% headcount growth, lifting operating margin to 10.1% from 7.6%. Net income of $72M grew more slowly than operating profit because the tax provision jumped to $9.2M from $1.2M, reflecting a one-time prior-year release of uncertain tax positions. Nutanix held $718.8M cash plus $1,299.1M short-term investments, repurchased $50.0M of stock, and raised its buyback authorization by $750.0M in April 2026. No forward guidance was disclosed.

drivers.explanation: Revenue grew 10% y/y as subscription and support renewals scaled with the customer base, while disciplined opex growth widened operating margin to 10.1% from 7.6%; ARR rose 14.9% y/y to $2.43B.

Product revenue rose 6% on increased software adoption from renewals and new-customer programs; support/maintenance revenue rose 15% as the end-customer base grew about 11%, driving related subscription and support renewals.

Product cost of revenue fell on lower operating- and finance-lease overhead, while support-cost growth from higher support-organization headcount trailed revenue growth, keeping total gross margin roughly flat at 86.9%.
Sales & marketing, R&D, and G&A expenses each grew 0-9% y/y on measured 7-10% headcount growth and higher event/legal/IT costs, all slower than 10% revenue growth, expanding operating margin.
Net income grew slower than operating income because the tax provision jumped to $9.2M from $1.2M, after a prior-year release of uncertain tax positions had lowered the year-ago comparison.
